import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    import collections
    bg=collections.Counter(v for r in g for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # find 4 cells
    pts=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v==4]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    dirs=[(1,1),(1,-1),(-1,1),(-1,-1)]
    # try each direction: extend ray from each 4-cell
    best=None
    for d in dirs:
        for (i,j) in pts:
            # walk from this 4-cell outward
            cells=[]; ii, jj=i+d[0],j+d[1]
            while 0<=ii<H and 0<=jj<W and g[ii][jj]==bg:
                cells.append((ii,jj)); ii+=d[0]; jj+=d[1]
            if len(cells)>1:
                cand={(p[0]+q[0],p[1]+q[1]) for p,q in [(a,b) for a in cells for b in cells]}|set() 
                # actually overlay all cells
                cells=set(cells)
                for c_ in cells: out[c_[0]][c_[1]]=3
                if best is None or len(cells)>len(best): best=cells
    return out

def f(g):
    pts=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v==4]
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=collections.Counter(v for r in g for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]

        while 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W and g[nr][nc]==bg:
            out[nr][nc]=3; nr+=dx; nc+=dy
    return out

    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=collections.Counter(v for r in g for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    pts={(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]!=bg}
    seen=set(); groups=[]
    for p in pts:
        if p in seen: continue
        comp=set([p]); st=[p]; visited=set()
        while st:
            a,b=st.pop()
            if (a,b) in visited: continue
            visited.add((a,b))
            for da in(-1,0,1):
                for db in(-1,0,1):
                    n=(a+da,b+db)
                    if n in comp: continue
                    if n in pts and n not in visited:
                        comp.add(n); st.append(n)
        seen|=comp; groups.append(comp)
    def sgn(x): return 1 if x>0 else -1 if x!=0 else 0
    for grp in groups:
        if len(grp)<2: continue
        a=min(grp); b=max(grp)
        dy,dx=sgn(b[0]-a[0]),sgn(b[1]-a[1])
        # iterate rays; paint set tracks already painted to avoid rework
        for start,d in [(min(grp),(dy,dx)),(max(grp),(-dy,-dx))]:
            p=start; bounced=0
            while True:
                nr,nc=p[0]+d[0],p[1]+d[1]
                if not(0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W): break
                if g[nr][nc]==bg:
                    out[nr][nc]=3; p=(nr,nc); continue
                if (nr,nc) in grp: p=(nr,nc); continue
                if bounced==1: break
                nd=(d[0],-d[1])
                nn,nm=nr+nd[0],nc+nd[1]
                if not(0<=nn<H and 0<=nm<W): break
                if g[nn][nm]==bg or (nn,nm) in grp:
                    d=nd; p=(nn,nm); bounced+=1; continue
                break
    return out
for k in ['Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5']:
    print(k, f(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])

from collections import Counter
import os,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]!=bg]
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for p in sorted(pts):
        if p in seen: continue
        st=[p];seen.add(p);cc=[p]
        while st:
            q=st.pop()
            col=g[q[0]][q[1]]
            for dr in (-1,0,1):
                for dc in (-1,0,1):
                    n=(q[0]+dr,q[1]+dc)
                    if 0<=n[0]<H and 0<=n[1]<W and g[n[0]][n[1]]==col and n not in seen:
                        seen.add(n);st.append(n);cc.append(n)
        if len(cc)>=2:
            ccs=[g[p[0]][p[1]] for p in cc]
            if len(set(ccs))==1:
                rdiff=max(abs(a-b) for a,b in zip([p[0] for p in cc],[q[0] for q in cc]))
                diffs=sorted(set((abs(cc[i+1][0]-cc[i][0]),abs(cc[i+1][1]-cc[i][1])) for i in range(len(cc)-1)))
                ok=all(max(dr,dj) in (1,0) or max(dr,dj)==0 for dr,dj in diffs)
                # check consecutive diagonal steps
                diagall = all(((cc[i+1][0]-cc[i][0])==1 and abs(cc[i+1][1]-cc[i][1])==1) or ((cc[i+1][0]-cc[i][0])==-1 and abs(cc[i+1][1]-cc[i][1])==1) for i in range(len(cc)-1))
                if diagall:
                    comps.append(cc)
    mk=min(comps,key=len)
    mv=g[mk[0][0]][mk[0][1]]
    a,b=sorted(mk)
    d=(b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1])
    s=(d[0]>0)-(d[0]<0),(d[1]>0)-(d[1]<0)
    g2=[row[:] for row in g]
    def shoot(start,ddir):
        i,j=start
        while True:
            ni,nj=i+ddir[0],j+ddir[1]
            if not(0<=ni<H and 0<=nj<W): break
            v=g[ni][nj]
            if v==mv: i,j=ni,nj; continue
            if v==bg: 
                g2[ni][nj]=3; i,j=ni,nj; continue
            dd=(ddir[0],-ddir[1])
            ni,nj=i+dd[0],j+dd[1]
            if not(0<=ni<H and 0<=nj<W): break
            if g[ni][nj]==mv or g[ni][nj]==bg: i,j=ni,nj
            else: break
    shoot(a,s);shoot(b,(-s[0],-s[1]))
    return g2
for p in ['5','6','7','8']:
    gi=G['Demo pair %s input'%p]; go=G['Demo pair %s output'%p]
    o=solve(gi)
    diff=[(r,c) for r in range(len(go)) for c in range(len(go[0])) if go[r][c]!=o[r][c]]
    print(p,'MATCH' if not diff else 'DIFF n=%d'%len(diff),diff[:14])

from collections import Counter
def comps_2(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]!=bg]
    seen=set(); cs=[]
    for p in sorted(pts):
        if p in seen: continue
        col=g[p[0]][p[1]]; st=[p];seen.add(p);cc=[p]
        while st:
            q=st.pop()
            for dr in (-1,0,1):
                for dc in (-1,0,1):
                    n=(q[0]+dr,q[1]+dc)
                    if 0<=n[0]<H and 0<=n[1]<W and g[n[0]][n[1]]==col and n not in seen:
                        seen.add(n);st.append(n);cc.append(n)
        rs=[c[0] for c in cc]; cs2=[c[1] for c in cc]
        hh=max(rs)-min(rs)+1; ww=max(cs2)-min(cs2)+1
        kind=('M' if abs(hh-ww)<=1 else 'O')
        cs.append((cc,col,kind,hh,ww))
    return cs,bg
def solve(g):
    cs,bg=comps_2(g)
    mcomp=min([c[0] for c in cs if c[2]=='M'],key=lambda c:len(c[0]))
    mv=mcomp[1]
    a=min(mcomp,key=lambda p:p[0]); b=max(mcomp,key=lambda p:p[0])
    def unit(v): return (1 if v>0 else -1 if v<0 else 0)
    dr0,dc0=unit(b[0]-a[0]),unit(b[1]-a[1])
    # object -> orientation: tall vertical wall -> flips horiz comp
    objs={}
    for cc,col,kind,hh,ww in cs:
        if kind=='O':
            k=min(cc)
            tl=bool(hh>=ww)
            objs[k]=tl
    def shoot(start,d):
        i,j=start
        while True:
            ni,nj=i+d[0],j+d[1]
            if not(0<=ni<H and 0<=nj<W): break
            v=g[ni][nj]
            if v==mv or v==bg:
                if v==bg: out[ni][nj]=3
                i,j=ni,nj; continue
            tl=objs.get((ni,nj),False)
            d=(d[0]*(-1 if tl else 1), d[1]*(-1 if not tl else 1))
            ni,nj=i+d[0],j+d[1]
            if not(0<=ni<H and 0<=nj<W): break
            if g[ni][nj]==mv or g[ni][nj]==bg: i,j=ni,nj; continue
            break
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    shoot(a,(dr0,dc0)); shoot(b,(-dr0,-dc0))
    return out

from collections import Counter
def comps_2(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]!=bg]
    seen=set(); cs=[]
    for p in sorted(pts):
        if p in seen: continue
        col=g[p[0]][p[1]]; st=[p];seen.add(p);cc=[p]
        while st:
            q=st.pop()
            for dr in (-1,0,1):
                for dc in (-1,0,1):
                    n=(q[0]+dr,q[1]+dc)
                    if 0<=n[0]<H and 0<=n[1]<W and g[n[0]][n[1]]==col and n not in seen:
